title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
name_bilingual: 战斗体验改善器 / Combat Experience Enhancer
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Static 65 - Combat Experience Enhancer

preimages.meaning: 中文：把通用技能查询的首个比较改为自比较。 / English: Replace the first generic-skill comparison with a self-comparison.

known_risks: 中文：源代码把通用技能查询的首个比较强制为相等，影响面极广；可能让大量未勾选技能也被判定为生效，应单独测试。 / English: The source forces the first comparison in the generic skill query to equal, giving it an extremely broad blast radius; many unrelated skills may be treated as active, so test it in isolation.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把 3DS 静态 ARM 金手指 #65“战斗体验改善器”转换为 JP v96 Wii U PPC 固定地址补丁；默认关闭，状态为 Runtime Experimental。 / English: Converts 3DS static ARM cheat #65 "Combat Experience Enhancer" into fixed-address JP-v96 Wii U PPC patches; disabled by default and classified Runtime Experimental.
